text:
jess (AE): Quick kickoff — SolsticePay POC. They want a drop-in swap from CompetitorX to Redwood: HTTP surface compat, prompt parity, and token-billing parity. Can SEs weigh in on what's feasible in a 2-week POC? cc @omar (SE) @mitch (ML Eng) @nina (Security)

omar (SE): I can run a mapping smoke. Need sample traffic (50-100 calls) and a couple of example responses. Two likely gaps: streaming chunk framing and default stop-token behavior. We can build a small proxy to normalize both. If they share samples I can have a smoke today. :eyes:

mitch (ML Eng): For prompt parity we need their golden prompts + acceptance metrics. I'd run top-5 response variance and embedding-sim tests. Suggest configs: rwd-full, rwd-quant, and a lightweight baseline. I can set up an eval harness; how many prompts do they have? 200-500 is ideal.

nina (Security): Heads up — they called out PCI scope and data residency. Questions we'll need answered: where does request data live, KMS/HSM requirements, retention windows, and RBAC for logs. If they insist on air-gapped, we'll move to Private deployment. Please flag any legal asks early.

li (SRE): Capacity note: if they need sustained 100 TPS with low p50/p95, Dedicated capacity + burst policy is safest. Also CompetitorX keeps KV cache keyed per session — we should emulate session affinity at the proxy layer to preserve latency for stateful flows.

jess (AE): Pricing Q from buyer: token-for-token parity for the POC (they want to compare spend). Also asked about a month-long trial credit and committed discount tiers after POC. What's standard here?

omar (SE): On token parity — batching, quant, and prefix caching change effective token counts. We'll provide a measurement mapping document (client_tokens -> measured_server_tokens) and a small meter they can run against both endpoints. For the POC I recommend we waive meter costs (trial credit) and supply raw logs so they can verify.

omar (SE): Example proxy curl for the smoke:
```
curl -X POST https://proxy.example.com/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \
  -d '{"prompt":"{{prompt}}","max_tokens":250,"stream":false}'
```
Proxy responsibilities: rewrite stop sequences, normalize `temperature` to [0,1], and reframe streaming chunks into single-response for parity.

mitch (ML Eng): Eval plan: I'll run pairwise embedding cosine + token-delta histogram for 500 prompts. Will output top-10 divergence cases and a summary CSV. Expect initial results in 48 hours.

nina (Security): I've attached the minimal security questionnaire link — ask them to fill before infra is provisioned: https://redwood.example.com/sec-portal/solsticepay. Key required answers: data retention, PII handling, KMS provider, SOC2 attestations, and any regulatory constraints.

jess (AE): Action items — Omar: mapping shim + smoke by EOD. Mitch: eval harness kickoff, share results to #eng-ml. Nina: send questionnaire template and chase. Li: rough Dedicated sizing + latency SLOs. I'll draft pricing terms and a trial-credit note and loop legal if needed. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging-proxy-solsticepay -> 1761240000 (test run). Please don't push unrelated commits to that cluster until tests complete.

omar (SE): Got it, starting now.

mitch (ML Eng): On it, will upload results to the POC drive.

nina (Security): I'll DM the customer the questionnaire and log the ticket.

jess (AE): Thanks team — I'll update the customer after the EOD smoke.

li (SRE): noted. Will post sizing by EOD.

jess (AE): thanks everyone! :rocket:
